name: subagent-statusline
description: Runs a subagentStatusLine-style command and draws its output as the subagent rows under the prompt

command.title: Command
command.description: Shell command run with the legacy subagentStatusLine JSON on stdin; it prints one {"id","content"} JSON line per row. Empty: use subagentStatusLine.command from ~/.claude/settings.json.

refreshMs.title: Refresh interval (ms)
refreshMs.description: How often the command runs while an agent is running. The engine's own was 5000.
